description: You are a GIS Platform Architect preparing for a high-traffic public map launch. Log in to GeoServer at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (admin / Admin123!). Configure tile caching for the ne:ne_countries layer by doing all of the following: (1) Open the tile layer configuration for ne:ne_countries in the Tile Caching section. Add the EPSG:900913 (Web Mercator) gridset to the layer's gridsets if it is not already present. Ensure image/png is configured as a tile format. Set the metatiling factor to 4x4 or larger. Save the configuration. (2) Trigger a tile seeding operation for ne:ne_countries: gridset EPSG:4326, image format image/png, zoom levels 0 to 3, covering the full world extent (minX=-180, minY=-90, maxX=180, maxY=90). Start the seeding process.
